backend/main.mo: Defines the main actor with user profiles, love language data, rituals, challenges, photos, authorization mixins, and storage, exposing all core backend types for the app.
backend/migration.mo: Provides type definitions and structures for state migration, covering rituals, stats, badges, challenges, and quiz data for upgraded canister versions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence record linking a frontend multi-entry ritual history update to affected files, components, and requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains human-written summaries of key frontend files including pages, hooks, components, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles implementing light/dark theme tokens, color variables, and base layout rules.
frontend/index.html: App entry HTML defining root container, metadata, mobile settings, and script loader for the frontend bundle.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: Manual QA checklist detailing verification steps for pairing, daily rituals, history, and general app functionality.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component handling authentication, profile setup flow, and tab-based navigation between pages.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with icons and tab switching behavior.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Displays a floating heart animation generated on mount for completion feedback.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Shows detailed harmony metrics including current score, 7‑day trend, and contributing factors.
Compact harmony summary card that shows percent and trend and links to Insights.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Login/logout button using Internet Identity with loading states and error handling.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Placeholder card announcing upcoming love challenge features.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Displays love language status with a primary action button and link to Insights.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Collects and submits the user’s name during initial profile setup with success/error states.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Displays placeholder progress visuals including a heart-shaped progress meter and milestone indicators for user challenge progress.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Implements an animated spinning wheel that selects a love language, with daily spin logic persisted in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Shows love‑language‑themed activity packs with streak‑based unlock requirements and lets users view pack details.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, stored identities, and AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, pairing, rituals, and other backend data using the actor instance.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind layers, a light/dark theme color system using OKLCH, base typography, and several custom animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and the InternetIdentityProvider, then renders App.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Displays love‑activity features with pairing checks, admin overrides, decorative animations, and components like LoveChallenges, RewardVisuals, and a spin wheel.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Renders the daily ritual flow with text, photos, love‑language context, history entries, and completion animations using multiple backend queries.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Shows relationship insights including streaks, harmony scores, quiz overlap, trends, and badge milestones with admin-aware gating.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Implements the love‑languages quiz, mapping UI answers to backend enums, saving/resetting results, and showing progress and navigation.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Renders a list of ritual history entries with expandable details, formatted dates, love‑language metadata, and user responses with photos.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: Manages user pairing flow, profile checks, admin state, and combined quiz state, including pairing code generation and completion UI.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Provides helpers to convert harmony values to percentages, normalize 7‑day trend data, and generate trend labels and display metadata.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL/query/hash parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and removing them from the URL.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, typography, fonts, shadows, animations, and container settings for the app’s design system.
project_state.json: Describes overall project state and enumerates existing app features, including authentication, pairing, rituals, insights, and backend roles.
